Same counter data: 3.6 % is winter's share of the year's passages; 7.6 % is the winter daily rate against the rest-of-year daily rate.

a.xlink:title: The mandate asks for a permanent bidirectional lane on one side with parking restored: not 'as is' in any month.
The service request makes the winter removal Volet 1, « mesure transitoire pour l'hiver 2026-2027 », ahead of Volet 2, the permanent reconfiguration; nothing released withdraws Volet 2.

The window only: the office's « d'avril à décembre » kept implies January–March removed (three months); he said four months, December to March. Otherwise the two statements agree (seasonal; one side kept).
